description: This PHP source file defines the 'AccountFormBase' class, which provides functionality to handle account form rendering, data validation, duplicate checking, and saving within a SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for building HTML forms, checking for duplicate accounts, and persisting account data to the database.

classes.name: AccountFormBase
classes.description: Provides methods for rendering, validating, and saving account type forms within the SuiteCRM application. Handles duplicate detection, form building, and data persistence for account records.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AccountFormBase object by obtaining a database manager instance.

methods.name: checkForDuplicates
methods.description: Checks the database for existing accounts with matching name or address fields to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: buildTableForm
methods.description: Generates an HTML form displaying a list of account records for selection or confirmation.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Builds and returns the HTML form for creating or editing an account.

methods.name: getFormBody
methods.description: Constructs the body of the account form with fields for account details, including name, phone, and website.

methods.name: getWideFormBody
methods.description: Creates a more detailed, wide version of the account form, including address and contact information.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes form submissions to save account data, handles duplicates, permissions, and redirects upon completion.
